currentParagraphText: “That’s fair,” Vilas shrugged, his worry significantly reduced if not eliminated entirely. He was already looking forward to what kind of skill Jake would get, but going by the aura in the air, he kind of already knew.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: Artemis was right, though. It was best to wait and see until he opened his eyes, as who knew what Vilas’ dear little Chosen had going through his mind. Hopefully, he would just take the win and disengage his mind from the space he found himself in sooner rather than later.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “He actually did,” Artemis said with astonishment. “However, he’s not entirely out of the woods yet, and I wouldn’t celebrate before he opens his eyes.”
